[[File:Traemane.png|alt=White stag with golden antlers on field of green|thumb|Sigil of House Traemane]]
'''House Traemane''' is one of the 19 Major [[:Category:Noble houses|Noble houses]] of [[Andor]]. Its current [[High Seat]] is [[Lady]] [[Ellorien Traemane]] and her estates are at Sheldyn.

Lady Ellorien's grandmother was named [[Elayne Traemane]].

==House Sigil==
The sigil of House Traemane is a golden antlered white stag, known as the White Stag of Traemane.

==Activities==
During the [[Succession Wars#Third Succession War|Third Succession War]], House Traemane supported [[House Trakand]].{{ref/book|5|19}}

During the [[Fourth Succession War]], House Traemane did not support [[House Trakand]], even when Elayne had gathered enough Houses to gain the [[Lion Throne]]. The main reason behind this was the fact that [[Morgase Trakand]], while under the influence of [[Gaebril]], had its High Seat flogged.

House Traemane had ''very'' favourable tax deals for their fruit orchards under Morgase. [[Lelaine Akashi]] questions [[Gawyn Trakand]] about Elayne's intentions towards the favourable taxes given to House Traemane. Gawyn responds that Elayne would probably be more strict because she had always thought that favourable position no longer justfied. Lelaine mentions Traemane's northen cherry orchards were not very productive lately.{{ref/book|12|30}}

Traemane has said that it will march behind the Lion of Andor out of necessity when the [[Last Battle]] comes and no sooner. There is a still a great deal of animosity between Trakand and Traemane.{{ref/book|11|35}}
